theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {f g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i := by
  let n := Fintype.card ι
  let s_f := ∑ i, f i
  let s_g := ∑ i, g i
  let s_fg := ∑ i, f i * g i

  have h1 : s_fg ≤ (s_f * s_g) / n :=
    by
      rw [Nat.cast_div]
      apply div_le_div
      exact (Nat.cast_pos n).trans (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos n) (Nat.cast_pos s_f) (Nat.cast_pos s_g))
      apply le_mul_div
      exact (le_mul_div s_f s_g n).trans (Antivary.sum_le_div hfg)

  have h2 : (s_f * s_g) / n ≤ (s_f * s_g) :=
    by
      rw [Nat.cast_div]
      apply div_le
      exact (Nat.cast_pos n).trans (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos n) (Nat.cast_pos s_f) (Nat.cast_pos s_g))

  rw [Nat.cast_mul] at h1
  apply Nat.cast_le
  exact (h1.trans h2)
